summary: eToro Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Notice and Proxy Statement for its Annual Meeting of Shareholders to be held on May 26, 2026. The meeting covers routine matters such as re-election of directors. No financial terms, premium, or special-situation event is present. The filing is a standard annual meeting notification, not a special situation. As a foreign private issuer, this 6-K corresponds to a US proxy solicitation. No action required; watch for standard proxy voting deadlines.
